sentences.en: Hey, Shankar Vedantam here.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是香卡·维丹塔姆。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for listening to my podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢收听我的播客。

sentences.en: I want to bring you a special Hidden Brain bonus episode for your weekend.
sentences.zh: 我想在周末为你带来一期特别的《隐藏的大脑》加长节目。

sentences.en: One idea that intrigues me is the intersection of magic and psychology.
sentences.zh: 有一个令我着迷的想法，那就是魔术与心理学的交汇点。

sentences.en: It just so happens that longtime NPR producer Barry Gordimer is also a talented magician.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，NPR 的资深制作人巴里·戈迪默也是一位才华横溢的魔术师。

sentences.en: So we teamed up to bring you a new segment we're going to call Magic Brain.
sentences.zh: 所以我们合作推出了一个新板块，我们打算叫它“魔术大脑”。

sentences.en: I'm joined in the studio now by Melissa Melnicki.
sentences.zh: 现在演播室里和我在一起的是梅丽莎·梅尔尼基。

sentences.en: She's NPR's talent relations manager, but the real reason she's here with me right now
sentences.zh: 她是 NPR 的人才关系经理，但她今天坐在我这里的真正原因

sentences.en: is that she is an unsuspecting volunteer for an experiment that we're about to run on her.
sentences.zh: 是她将作为一名毫无防备的志愿者，配合我们即将对她进行的一项实验。

sentences.en: Melissa, hello.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎，你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Shankar.
sentences.zh: 你好，香卡。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm doing great.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: I'm not sure you're doing so great,
sentences.zh: 我可不确定你是不是真的很好，

sentences.en: and you might not be doing so great after I introduce you to our other visitor
sentences.zh: 等我向你介绍我们演播室里的另一位访客后，

sentences.en: who is in the studio with us.
sentences.zh: 你可能就没那么好了。

sentences.en: Barry Gordimer is a producer at Morning Edition,
sentences.zh: 巴里·戈迪默是《早安晨报》的制作人，

sentences.en: but the reason he's here is that for 15 years, Barry used to be a professional magician.
sentences.zh: 但他来这里的理由是，巴里曾做过 15 年的职业魔术师。

sentences.en: My stage name was The Sort of Amazing Barry.
sentences.zh: 我的艺名是“堪称惊艳的巴里”。

sentences.en: Sort of amazing, because I wasn't quite as good as the other magicians out there.
sentences.zh: 之所以说是“堪称惊艳”，是因为我没有其他魔术师那么厉害。

sentences.en: Barry, I think you're going to show Melissa something.
sentences.zh: 巴里，我想你要给梅丽莎展示点东西。

sentences.en: I have a deck of cards in my hand.
sentences.zh: 我手里有一副牌。

sentences.en: You can see they're all different.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到它们各不相同。

sentences.en: I'm going to spread them out in my hands, face down.
sentences.zh: 我要把它们在手中背朝上展开。

sentences.en: Please take a card, any card.
sentences.zh: 请抽一张牌，随便哪张。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: Melissa, careful now.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎，小心点。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Whatever you think you're going to pick first,
sentences.zh: 无论你觉得你最先想选哪张，

sentences.en: don't pick that card and pick a completely different card.
sentences.zh: 都不要选那张，选一张完全不同的。

sentences.en: Or not.
sentences.zh: 或者不这样也行。

sentences.en: Any card.
sentences.zh: 随便哪张。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Picking a card and not being manipulated.
sentences.zh: 抽一张牌，并且不受操控。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: So Melissa has extracted a card.
sentences.zh: 所以梅丽莎已经抽出一张牌了。

sentences.en: Take a look at that card.
sentences.zh: 看一眼那张牌。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: I'm going to cut the deck in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我要从中间把牌切开。

sentences.en: Please drop your card in there.
sentences.zh: 请把你的牌放进去。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Shagra, why don't you take a card?
sentences.zh: 夏格拉，你为什么不也抽一张牌？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm going to do the same thing.
sentences.zh: 我要做同样的事情。

sentences.en: I'm going to think of a card,
sentences.zh: 我要想一张牌，

sentences.en: and I'm going to change the card that I pick right now
sentences.zh: 然后我要改变我刚才选的那张牌，

sentences.en: and pick a different card.
sentences.zh: 去选一张不同的牌。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: I have looked at my card.
sentences.zh: 我已经看过了我的牌。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Put it in the deck there, and...
sentences.zh: 把它放回牌堆里，然后……

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: On the count of three,
sentences.zh: 数到三，

sentences.en: I would like for you to say the name of your card out loud.
sentences.zh: 我想请你大声说出你抽的牌的名字。

sentences.en: One, two, three.
sentences.zh: 一，二，三。

sentences.en: Queen of Hearts.
sentences.zh: 红桃 Q。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Are you kidding?
sentences.zh: 开玩笑吧？

sentences.en: That...
No, that blew my mind.
sentences.zh: 不，这太震撼了。

sentences.en: How in the world did you do that, Barry?
sentences.zh: 巴里，你到底是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: As magicians like to say, very well.
sentences.zh: 正如魔术师们喜欢说的，无可奉告。

sentences.en: Clearly you did this very well.
sentences.zh: 显然你这做得太棒了。

sentences.en: This is astonishing, Barry.
sentences.zh: 这太惊人了，巴里。

sentences.en: How did you know what I was going to pick?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道我会选哪张？

sentences.en: This was an exercise in the manipulation of choice.
sentences.zh: 这是一次关于选择操纵的练习。

sentences.en: I forced you to take the same card.
sentences.zh: 我强迫你拿了同一张牌。

sentences.en: You did not.
sentences.zh: 你才没有。

sentences.en: I made a free choice to pick the card that I picked, Barry.
sentences.zh: 巴里，我是在自由选择的情况下选了我选的那张牌的。

sentences.en: Thank you for saying that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么说。

sentences.en: That's what I wanted you to think.
sentences.zh: 这正是我想要你以为的。

sentences.en: But I...
sentences.zh: 但我……

sentences.en: Oh!
sentences.zh: 哦！

sentences.en: And the key to it, the key to it is you felt you had the freedom to do it.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，关键在于你觉得你有这样做的自由。

sentences.en: So this is fascinating because, of course,
sentences.zh: 所以这很迷人，因为当然，

sentences.en: there's a whole body of social science research, Barry,
sentences.zh: 巴里，有一整套社会科学研究，

sentences.en: that looks at this idea that you can actually nudge people
sentences.zh: 都在研究这样一个观点：你实际上可以引导人们

sentences.en: into doing certain things while making them feel like they have freedom of choice.
sentences.zh: 去做某些事情，同时让他们觉得自己拥有选择的自由。

sentences.en: And, you know, marketers have obviously been using these techniques on us for many years,
sentences.zh: 你知道，营销人员显然多年来一直在我们身上使用这些技巧，

sentences.en: nudging us to buy this brand of soap rather than that brand of soap.
sentences.zh: 引导我们买这个牌子的肥皂而不是那个牌子的肥皂。

sentences.en: But it gets really interesting when you're talking about manipulating really important life decisions.
sentences.zh: 但当你谈到操纵非常重要的人生决策时，这就变得非常有趣了。

sentences.en: So researchers have found, for example,
sentences.zh: 因此，研究人员发现，例如，

sentences.en: that you can influence whether people join a retirement savings plan when they start a new job.
sentences.zh: 你可以影响人们在开始新工作时是否加入退休储蓄计划。

sentences.en: If you make the default option that you're automatically enrolled unless you opt out,
sentences.zh: 如果你设定默认选项为：除非你选择退出，否则自动注册，

sentences.en: more people choose to participate in these savings plans
sentences.zh: 与默认选项为不自动注册且必须选择注册的情况相比，

sentences.en: compared to when the default option is you're not automatically signed up
sentences.zh: 会有更多人选择参与这些储蓄计划。

sentences.en: and you have to choose to sign up.
sentences.zh: 人们往往觉得自己有自由选择的权力，

sentences.en: People tend to feel like they have a free choice
sentences.zh: 但事实上，无论那个选项是什么，他们实际上往往都会选择默认选项。

sentences.en: when, in fact, they actually tend to choose the default option no matter what that option is.
sentences.zh: 其中的关键点在于，人们在一开始不能意识到你正试图影响他们，

sentences.en: The key point in that is people can't be aware initially that you are trying to influence them
sentences.zh: 因为这会影响选择。

sentences.en: because that influences the choice.
sentences.zh: 现在，在这种情况下，香卡，你知道我要耍个把戏，

sentences.en: Now, in this context, Shankar, you knew I was going to pull a trick,
sentences.zh: 所以你试图影响我的做法，并试图影响梅丽莎的做法。

sentences.en: so you tried to influence what I was doing and influence what Melissa was doing.
sentences.zh: 说来也巧，作为一名职业魔术师，

sentences.en: And funny enough, as a professional magician,
sentences.zh: 我总是发现，当人们试图搞砸我的魔术时，

sentences.en: I always found it easier to get someone to pick the card I wanted them to pick
sentences.zh: 反而更容易让他们选我希望他们选的牌。

sentences.en: when they were trying to mess me up.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当他们试图弄清楚你如何操纵他们时，

sentences.en: So in other words, when they were trying to figure out what you were doing to manipulate them,
sentences.zh: 你发现更容易操纵他们了？

sentences.en: you found it easier to manipulate them?
sentences.zh: 是的，确实如此。

sentences.en: Yes, I did.
sentences.zh: 我想原因之一是，当这种事发生时人们总是在笑。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons, I think, is because people are always laughing when this goes on.
sentences.zh: 而你在笑的时候很难进行批判性思考。

sentences.en: And it's difficult to do critical thinking while you're laughing.
sentences.zh: 我想我要怪梅丽莎，因为我觉得大部分笑声都是她发出的。

sentences.en: I think I'm going to blame Melissa here because I think she did most of the laughing.
sentences.zh: 是的，我确实笑得挺多的。

sentences.en: Yes, I did laugh quite a bit.
sentences.zh: 好的，下次我们不在演播室里有梅丽莎的情况下做同样的魔术。

sentences.en: All right, next time, we will do the same trick without Melissa in the studio.
sentences.zh: 我确信，巴里·戈迪默，你绝对糊弄不了我。

sentences.en: And I'm sure, Barry Gordemur, you will not fool me.
sentences.zh: 我接受这个挑战。

sentences.en: I'll take that challenge.
sentences.zh: 巴里·戈迪默，我想感谢你今天抽出时间陪我们。

sentences.en: Barry Gordemur, I want to thank you for making some time for us today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很享受进入你脑子的过程。

sentences.en: I enjoy getting in your head.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎·梅尔尼基，非常感谢你的到来。

sentences.en: Melissa Melnicki, thank you so much for coming in.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: This is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这个节目是《隐藏的大脑》。
